name: @pavlo-skuibida/mcp-trophy-hunter
description: MCP server for PlayStation trophy hunting — see your games, trophy lists with rarity, and next-trophy suggestions via Claude
author: Pavlo Skuibida

scripts.build: tsc && esbuild dist/index.js --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --format=esm --outfile=dist/bundle.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.inspector: npm run build && npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector node dist/bundle.mjs
